differences: Two Table 1 values do not reproduce and are not used as checks: the SD of age is 5.8 years in the deposit (Table 1 prints 8) and the mean 400 m walking time is 389.56 s (Table 1 prints 389.5; the other 400 m statistic, SD 63 s, does reproduce).

The deposit holds the 71 older adults the paper analysed (25 further recruits were excluded by the authors and are not in the deposit), so no participant is flagged as excluded. The sample text of the paper gives age 75 +- 7 for all 96 recruited older adults; Table 1 (age 75 +- 8 for the 71 analysed) is what is reproduced here.
The paper's EEG and gait-variability outcomes come from the EEG, insole and IMU recordings, which are not part of the converted file, so they are not reproduced.
